source: namespace Business;public static class Entry{public static int Run(int n,int[] a,string s){int[] input=new int[]{1,2,3,4};int[] trace=new int[6];int t=0;int count=0;foreach(int item in input){trace[t++]=item;if(item%2==0)count++;}int[] output=new int[count];int next=0;foreach(int item in input){if(item%2==0){trace[t++]=item;output[next++]=item;}}if(n==0)return output.Length;if(n==1)return output[0];if(n==2)return output[1];return trace[n-3];}}

namespace Business;public sealed class Set{public readonly int[] Items;public Set(int[] items){Items=items;}}public static class Entry{public static int Run(int n,int[] a,string s){for(int i=1;i<a.Length;i++){if(a[i-1]>=a[i])return -2;}int found=-1;int insertion=a.Length;for(int i=0;i<a.Length;i++){if(a[i]==n)found=i;if(insertion==a.Length&&a[i]>n)insertion=i;}if(found>=0)return -1;if(a.Length>=128)return -3;int[] output=new int[a.Length+1];for(int i=0;i<output.Length;i++){if(i<insertion)output[i]=a[i];else if(i==insertion)output[i]=n;else output[i]=a[i-1];}Set result=new Set(output);int hash=result.Items.Length;foreach(int item in result.Items){hash=hash*7+item;}return hash;}}

namespace Business;public sealed class Set{public readonly int[] Items;public Set(int[] items){Items=items;}}public static class Entry{public static int Run(int n,int[] a,string s){for(int i=1;i<a.Length;i++){if(a[i-1]>=a[i])return -2;}int found=-1;int insertion=a.Length;for(int i=0;i<a.Length;i++){if(a[i]==n)found=i;if(insertion==a.Length&&a[i]>n)insertion=i;}if(found<0)return -1;int[] output=new int[a.Length-1];for(int i=0;i<output.Length;i++){output[i]=a[i<found?i:i+1];}Set result=new Set(output);int hash=result.Items.Length;foreach(int item in result.Items){hash=hash*7+item;}return hash;}}

namespace Business;public readonly struct Pair{public readonly int Key;public readonly int Value;public Pair(int key,int value){Key=key;Value=value;}}public sealed class Map{public readonly Pair[] Items;public Map(Pair[] items){Items=items;}}public static class Entry{public static int Run(int n,int[] a,string s){if(a.Length%2!=0)return -2;int size=a.Length/2;for(int i=1;i<size;i++){if(a[(i-1)*2]>=a[i*2])return -2;}int found=-1;int insertion=size;for(int i=0;i<size;i++){if(a[i*2]==n)found=i;if(insertion==size&&a[i*2]>n)insertion=i;}if(found>=0)return -1;if(size>=128)return -3;Pair[] output=new Pair[size+1];for(int i=0;i<output.Length;i++){if(i<insertion)output[i]=new Pair(a[i*2],a[i*2+1]);else if(i==insertion)output[i]=new Pair(n,n*10);else output[i]=new Pair(a[(i-1)*2],a[(i-1)*2+1]);}Map result=new Map(output);int hash=result.Items.Length;foreach(Pair item in result.Items){hash=hash*7+item.Key;hash=hash*7+item.Value;}return hash;}}

namespace Business;public readonly struct Pair{public readonly int Key;public readonly int Value;public Pair(int key,int value){Key=key;Value=value;}}public sealed class Map{public readonly Pair[] Items;public Map(Pair[] items){Items=items;}}public static class Entry{public static int Run(int n,int[] a,string s){if(a.Length%2!=0)return -2;int size=a.Length/2;for(int i=1;i<size;i++){if(a[(i-1)*2]>=a[i*2])return -2;}int found=-1;int insertion=size;for(int i=0;i<size;i++){if(a[i*2]==n)found=i;if(insertion==size&&a[i*2]>n)insertion=i;}if(found<0)return -1;Pair[] output=new Pair[size];for(int i=0;i<size;i++){output[i]=new Pair(a[i*2],i==found?n*10:a[i*2+1]);}Map result=new Map(output);int hash=result.Items.Length;foreach(Pair item in result.Items){hash=hash*7+item.Key;hash=hash*7+item.Value;}return hash;}}

namespace Business;public static class Entry{public static int Run(int n,int[] a,string s){if(a.Length%2!=0)return -2;int size=a.Length/2;for(int i=1;i<size;i++){if(a[(i-1)*2]>=a[i*2])return -2;}int found=-1;int insertion=size;for(int i=0;i<size;i++){if(a[i*2]==n)found=i;if(insertion==size&&a[i*2]>n)insertion=i;}if(found<0)return -1;return a[found*2+1];}}
